newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Kwoon Chung ends debut up 31 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK's Kwoon Chung ends debut up 31 pct.

text.p: Shares in Hong Kong bus service operator Kwoon Chung Bus Holdings Ltd closed Wednesday, their first trading day, at HK$2.35 a share, 55 cents or 31 percent above the issue price of HK$1.80.
The shares traded between HK$2.225 and HK$2.50 on volume of 45.94 million shares worth a total of HK$109.35 million.
The issue of 59 million new shares was 53.5 times subscribed.
Analysts said the shares were boosted by hopes that Kwoon Chung's operation in China could successfully tap that nation's vast consumer market, analysts said.
"Its China concept aided demand for the shares," said Michael Ng, analyst from ASG Brokerage.

The company intends to use HK$93 million proceeds from the share flotation in its operations in Shanghai and planned operation in Harbin and Chaozhou, and to expand bus and other related businesses in Hong Kong.
But analysts saw limited upside on the Kwoon Chung shares due to its unexciting fundamentals.
